title: Skill Sync Config
description: Declarative configuration for upstream-synced skills. Consumed by internal/skills-maintenance/sync.mjs.

skill.description: Local skill directory name under skills/.

ref.description: Branch, tag, or full SHA to track.

sourcePath.description: Path inside the upstream repo whose contents are copied into skills/<skill>/.

lockedSha.description: Last verified upstream commit SHA. Rewritten by the runner.
